title: Operation Detail Execute Permission Consistency

items.action: start generic operations or cancel an operation from Operation Detail
start or retry a Bulk Email operation from Operation Detail
start an Enrichment or Scraper operation from Operation Detail

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

backend.reason: Existing operation Start authorization already selects the canonical business permission by operation type.

audit.reason: Existing operation execution audit behavior is unchanged.

route_guard.reason: Operation detail read access and mutation permissions remain separate concerns.

notes: Operation Detail remains readable with its existing read access. Bulk Email Start and Retry Failed use fair_crm.fair_emails.execute. Enrichment and Scraper Start use fair_crm.scraper.execute. Generic Start and Cancel continue to use fair_crm.operations.execute. Bulk Email export remains read-only under the existing backend export permission.
